definitions.explanation: A plant-based milk made from soybeans, widely consumed in Japan both as a beverage and as an ingredient in cooking. A key component in making tofu.

examples.english: I drink soy milk every morning.

notes:
USAGE:
{豆乳|とうにゅう} is a staple in Japanese cuisine and health food culture. Japan has a wide variety of flavored soy milk drinks available at convenience stores. In cooking, soy milk is the base ingredient for making ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧ (tofu) and is also used in hot pot dishes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豆乳|とうにゅう}⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: soy milk hot pot
- ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧{豆乳|とうにゅう}: adjusted soy milk (sweetened/flavored)
- {無調整|むちょうせい}{豆乳|とうにゅう}: unadjusted/plain soy milk
- {豆乳|とうにゅう}ラテ: soy milk latte
- {豆乳|とうにゅう}⟦プリン→プリン：11123_purin⟧: soy milk pudding
